prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Reordering sign-in earlier (after adoption selection or photo upload) was helpful (+3.3% to +5.5%), but placing it after the adoption certificate caused a severe drop (-22.4%).
Specific layout redesigns (Stage, Scroll, Grid, Checklist), select new screens (Visibility Check, Interactive Welcome, Sound Calibration), desktop background prompts, and clear hints (Path Selection, Sign-In Clarification, Multi-Account Preservation, Story Interaction) were helpful.
Copy updates, incentives, audio/sound cues, notification banners/toggles, and waiting screen info components showed no clear effect.
Several layout redesigns degraded performance severely (e.g., Photo Upload Grid -23.3%, Pick Friend Split -17.2%), while multiple new screens (Controls Overview, Bio Preview, Placement Guide, Troubleshooter) showed no clear effect.
Predictions were frequently too high for non-winning changes, projecting gains up to +12.0% on tests that showed no clear effect or degraded conversion.
Predictions were often too low for winning changes, predicting negative or modest impact (-5.0% to +3.7%) on features that ultimately delivered large wins (+3.3% to +14.0%).

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Spotlight Layout Redesign for Pick Friend Screen: Redesigns the pick friend screen to use a focused spotlight layout, placing emphasis on individual companion previews. (why: Adoption step has the biggest drop-off in conversion (73.1%) and a long mean time (1017s); standard layouts cause choice friction.)
1: [finish, new_screen] New Pet Interaction Basics Screen Before Home Intro: Inserts a dedicated screen before home intro showing users how to right-click, talk to, and hide their desktop pet. (why: 3 support tickets reported post-onboarding confusion on how to control, hide, or talk to their desktop pet.)
2: [adoption, redesign] Card Layout Redesign for Upload Photos Screen: Rebuilds the custom pet photo upload screen with a clean card layout showcasing sample photos and clear upload instructions. (why: 3 support emails reported custom pet creation failures or bad results, and adoption step conversion drops to 73.1%.)
3: [choose_path, new_screen] New Companion Visual Teaser Screen in Choose Path: Adds an inspiring visual showcase screen before path selection highlighting popular desktop companion behaviors. (why: Although initial path conversion is high (90.9%), setting clear visual expectations early improves overall finish completion (38.8%).)
4: [adoption, hint] Adoption Certificate Name Clarity Hint: Displays a clear hint on the adoption certificate screen explaining that pet names can be changed anytime in settings. (why: Users hesitate on certificate naming, contributing to the 89s median adoption step duration.)
5: [sign_in, copy] Sign-In Single Account Persistence Copy Clarification: Updates the sign-in screen messaging to clearly state that signing in restores and preserves existing pet profiles. (why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or reset after signing in again.)
6: [adoption, redesign] Card Layout Redesign for Adoption Certificate Screen: Redesigns the adoption certificate screen into an elegant structured card layout with clear visual hierarchy. (why: Adoption is the lowest converting onboarding step (73.1%); improving certificate layout structure increases completion confidence.)
7: [home, wait_info] Desktop Pet Launch Status Card on Waiting Screen: Adds a subtle status card component to the waiting screen showing current creation steps. (why: Users wait a median of 201s (mean 2336s) on the home/waiting step; reassurance prevents premature drop-off.)
8: [finish, new_flow] Desktop System Tray and Dock Setup Flow: Introduces a two-screen sub-flow before home intro explaining system tray controls and desktop overlay behaviors. (why: Support received multiple tickets about pets not appearing on desktop (3) and misbehaving desktop features post-setup (4).)
9: [home, hint] Desktop Ready Background Activity Hint: Displays a hint on the waiting screen explaining users can minimize the app while pet generation completes. (why: The waiting stage takes a mean of 2336s; reminding users they can safely minimize reduces drop-out rates.)

Clear hints on bottleneck steps perform consistently well with low implementation cost.
